messages:
noah_csm: Heads-up — renewal for Orion Labs is live next Wed. Procurement asked invoice to go to 'Orion Labs EU BV' and they want a delegated procurement signer. CFO OOO Tue-Wed.
eva_cs: Got it. Do we have their new vendor code and VAT number? They also requested a 9-month term instead of 12 — pricing will change.
marta_finance: Vendor code OL-EU-559. VAT: NL998776655. PO: OL-PO-559. Invoice to billing@orionlabs.eu. Prorated total for 9mo = EUR 61,200. Need billing contact name for invoice header.
harry_legal: Delegated signing acceptable if they supply a delegation letter referencing the procurement contact and delegation ref. Add an attestation checkbox on the envelope and include "Authorized under delegation ref: <ref>" in the signature block. Use "execution date" phrasing.
kevin_sales: Customer already uploaded delegation_letter.pdf and procurement contact is Jeroen van Dijk <jeroen@orionlabs.eu>. They said onboarding can start after procurement signs; CFO will countersign after return but doesn't block execution.
noah_csm: @docusign_bot please create envelope routing: procurement_jer -> marta_finance -> harry_legal. Add checkbox: "I attest I am authorized per attached delegation letter". Attach delegation letter and amendment once ready.
docusign_bot: Draft envelope created: envelope_id=env_OL_559. Routing set and checkbox placeholder added. Link: https://docusign.example/env/env_OL_559
eva_cs: Also the customer requires Dedicated KMS; include key fingerprint line in the amendment (they provided key id).
harry_legal: Added KMS fingerprint in section 3.2 and updated wording from "signature date" to "execution date". Approved.
noah_csm: Uploaded amendment_v2.pdf and sent envelope to procurement at 2024-07-03T16:45:00Z. Target: send today COB to keep onboarding kickoff.
docusign_bot: Envelope sent. Signature event: procurement_jer signed at 2024-07-03T17:02:11Z. Next recipient: marta_finance.
marta_finance: Signed and uploaded invoice PDF with VAT field filled and billing contact jeroen.accounts@orionlabs.eu.
docusign_bot: Signature event: marta_finance signed at 2024-07-03T17:25:00Z. Next: harry_legal.
harry_legal: Final review done, signed at 2024-07-03T17:40:05Z. Envelope completed. Final PDF: https://docusign.example/env/env_OL_559/final.pdf
kevin_sales: Customer confirmed VAT documents uploaded to their procurement portal. Onboarding kickoff scheduled for 2024-07-10.
noah_csm: Renewal executed 389 I'll update the tracker and schedule enablement. Thanks everyone.
